messages:
maria-support: Customer tenant-x5 reporting a spike in inference errors and ~5s tail latency on Dedicated EU cluster. Hit in prod at 2026-03-10T14:02Z. Error seen in responses: "internal_server_error" + no tokens returned. Can we collect repro data and a debug bundle?

deploy-bot: debug-bundle created: bundle_id=bdl-98a7f2, attach via https://internal/bundles/bdl-98a7f2 (auto-uploaded logs from control-plane).

josh-sre: can you paste a sample request id from the failing traces? need the X-Request-ID to grep across ingress and runtime logs. also which dedicated pool/node?

maria-support: sample X-Request-IDs: req_5f1a2c, req_5f1a2d, req_5f1a2e. Customer says it happened on tenant reserved pool eu-prod-gpu-pool-3. Pod seen: inference-tenantx5-7f6d4b8c.

akshay-support: sending customer curl repro now. they reported this command:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFIRE" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_5f1a2c" \
  -d '{"model": "rwd-optim-7b", "input": "summarize: <large document>"}'
```

akshay-support: they see: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error, body: {"error":"internal_server_error","code":500} and no tokens.

josh-sre: ok can someone run the following on the node and pod to capture transient state?

- kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-x5 get pods -o wide | grep tenantx5
- kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-x5 logs inference-tenantx5-7f6d4b8c --previous --tail=500
- kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-x5 describe pod inference-tenantx5-7f6d4b8c
- ssh node@gpu-node-eu-12 sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 500 --no-pager
- sudo dmesg | tail -n 100 (look for Xid or GPU errors)
- sudo nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE | head -n 200

josh-sre: also capture runtime logs: /var/log/redwood/runtime/request-traces.log (grep req_5f1a2c) and the per-request KV cache metric entries.

maria-support: attaching output from the customer (they forwarded quickly):

```
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] req=req_5f1a2c level=error msg="model inference failed" code=500 details="cuda: out of memory on GPU 0"
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] req=req_5f1a2c level=warn msg="evicted kv cache entries=512"
[2026-03-10T14:02:13Z] req=req_5f1a2c level=info msg="fallback to rwd-optim-4b variant" latency_ms=4800
```

maria-support: they also included a short pod log snippet: 

```
E0310 14:02:11.123456 1 runtime.cc:312] [req=req_5f1a2c] Kernel launch failed: cudaErrorUnknown: an illegal memory access was encountered
W0310 14:02:11.123789 1 batcher.cc:198] dropping request req_5f1a2d due to batch abort
```

josh-sre: looks like OOM / illegal mem access. could be driver or bad kernel on that node. please run nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -i 0,1,2 and paste. also collect `sudo cat /proc/$(pgrep -f runtime)/limits` to see RLIMITs.

tian-eng: for repro on our side, send a minimal curl that reproduces 100% in dev. try gradient of input length + streaming disabled:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: repro_local_01" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-optim-7b","input":"repeat(\"x\", 12000)","stream":false}' -s -D - -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
```

josh-sre: we should also pull `kubectl get node gpu-node-eu-12 -o json` and attach the allocatable/gpu annotation; sometimes our device plugin misreports.

akshay-support: customer ran nvidia-smi and returned:

```
GPU 0: 24320 MiB / 24576 MiB, 98 % util
GPU 1: 1024 MiB / 24576 MiB, 4 % util
GPU 2: 24570 MiB / 24576 MiB, 99 % util
```

akshay-support: they also saw dmesg lines with Xid 31 and Xid 63 around the time of the error.

josh-sre: Xid 31/63 indicates GPU hangs / TDR. we'll need a kernel dump. please run `sudo journalctl -k --since "2026-03-10 14:00" | head -n 200` and attach. also include /var/crash if any.

maria-support: bundle_id bdl-98a7f2 updated with customer attachments (nvidia-smi.txt, dmesg_slice.txt, pod_logs_inference.txt). I've added the request IDs and step-by-step curl into the bundle notes.

tian-eng: thanks — I'll try to repro locally on a spare node image and run with CUDA_MEMCHECK + ASAN on the kernel build. josh, would you want this routed to eng-runtime or eng-infra?

josh-sre: route to eng-runtime first (possible bad kernel/kernel-shim in runtime), cc eng-infra if node-level hardware failure. tagging @tian-eng.

akshay-support: customer is available for a screenshare at 16:00 UTC if needed.

maria-support: plan: collect full node bundle (rdctl collect-node --node gpu-node-eu-12 --bundle bdl-98a7f2), request coordinated pod restart, hold node out of rotation, and run the staged repro from tian. I'll schedule the maintenance window with the customer.

josh-sre: fine by me. once node bundle is uploaded, ping this thread and I'll pull /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and the kernel-dmesg. :thumbsup:

maria-support: bundle upload completed: bdl-98a7f2 (size 142MB) — added notes: repro curl + req ids + node metadata. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
